_readme: Image requests. Cloud sessions ADD items with status "pending"; the local session generates them in ChatGPT web, saves the jpg at `path` (under public/), sets status "done" and opens a PR. Pages pick the file up automatically when it exists.

requests.prompt: Flat vector illustration, 1600x900, 16:9. A party trivia night seen from above a table: a fanned stack of colourful question cards with large question marks, one card flipped to show a tick, a small round countdown timer, and a chunky scoreboard showing four teams with plus and minus buttons and tally numbers. Dark navy background (#0b0f1a) with neon cyan (#00e5ff), magenta and warm yellow accents, soft shadows, no text other than question marks and digits, no logos, no real people.
requests.alt: Illustrated trivia question cards beside a countdown timer and a four-team scoreboard

requests.prompt: Flat vector illustration, 1600x900, 16:9. Halloween trivia night: a glowing carved jack-o'-lantern next to a fanned stack of question cards with question marks, a bowl of wrapped candy and candy corn, a small countdown timer, bats and a crescent moon in the background. Dark purple-navy background with pumpkin orange, neon green and cyan accents. Friendly, not gory. No text other than question marks, no logos, no real people, no film characters.
requests.alt: Illustrated jack-o'-lantern, candy bowl and trivia question cards under a crescent moon
